goal: Allow running a transaction index alongside block pruning on storage-constrained nodes
Return candidate block hashes so clients can distinguish pruned transactions from nonexistent ones
Enable callers to retrieve missing pruned blocks on demand and complete transaction lookups
agreement: Substantive concept support for enabling txindex on pruned nodes (ajtowns, arejula27, optout21)
Addressed objections by returning structured error data and deferring partial indexing (arejula27, fjahr)
Unanswered suggestion to report pruned block hash in gettxoutproof with unspent outputs (arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it removes the mutual exclusivity between txindex and block pruning
Resolves long-standing requests from storage-constrained node operators needing tx lookups

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it provides structured error data when queried transactions reside in pruned blocks
Enables automated callers to programmatically retrieve missing blocks via getblockfrompeer
